g.text: ApprovalLoop — Bounded Autonomous Approval Operations Architecture
| Bounded unprompted orchestration • 4-Point deterministic safety • Transactional outbox • Progressive skill discovery
Triggers full Observe ➔ Decide ➔ Act ➔ Transition cycle
• ACID Transactions for Outbox Claim & State Guard
• Thread-safe in-memory dictionaries with transaction locks
• Zero-cloud setup for unit test suites & deterministic evals
• Claim Granted ➔ Acquire lock & start draft
• Atomic lock BEFORE calling Gemini API
• Zero authority over amount, recipient, or DB
Blocks side-effects if status is RESOLVED
Restricts synthetic test IDs in PRODUCTION
SIMULATED PROVIDER — NO REAL EMAIL TRANSMISSION
• Logs full delivery payload & metrics for autonomous auditability
CORE GOVERNANCE PRINCIPLE: “LLM PROPOSES. CODE DISPOSES.”
Gemini generates polite reminder wording only.
Transactions prevent duplicate actions & race collisions.
Python code owns authoritative business truth.
Audit ledger & OTel record every execution cycle.
Purely Observational Polling Plane (Zero Autonomous Tick Side-Effects):
RESULT: Intercepted by 4-Point Validator & Policy Engine
Status: BLOCKED • Side-effect ABORTED • Written to Audit Ledger
Race Condition Test Path (Agent vs Human)
1. Human signs off in parallel: Pending ➔ Resolved
2. Agent wakes up simultaneously: Pending ➔ Nudged
RESULT: Conditional State Guard Mismatch Detected
Human "Resolved" wins • Agent transition SKIPPED • Invariant Preserved
